struct HostAllowance
  std::vector<std::string> hosts
struct PickRequest
  std::string model
  bool fresh
  std::optional<HostAllowance> allowed
  std::string profile
struct Caller
  std::string user_description
  std::string path_description
struct Observation
  Caller caller
  std::int64_t took_ms
  std::int64_t cache_age_ms
struct Alias
  std::string host
  std::string name
  bool resident
  bool servable
  bool hosted
  std::vector<std::string> profiles
  std::vector<std::string> held_in
  std::int64_t context_length
  std::int64_t effective_context_length
struct Component
  std::string store
  std::string role
  std::string name
struct Family
  std::string family
  std::vector<Alias> names
  std::vector<std::string> held_in
  std::string family_source
  std::vector<Component> components
struct ModelsSnapshot
  Observation observation
  std::vector<Family> models
struct HostState
  std::string host
  std::string base
  bool up
  std::string why
  std::int64_t installed
  std::vector<std::string> resident
  bool servable
  bool hosted
  std::string wire
  std::string credential
  std::string declared_by
  std::vector<std::string> profiles
  std::string domain
  std::optional<std::string> availability_cause
struct Ask
  std::string at
  std::string caller
  std::string user
  std::string model
  std::string family
  std::string verdict
  std::string host
struct HostsSnapshot
  Observation observation
  std::vector<HostState> hosts
  std::vector<std::string> doubled
  std::vector<Ask> asked
struct Decision
  std::string asked
  std::string family
  std::string verdict
  std::string host
  std::string model
  std::string endpoint
  std::vector<std::string> installed_on
  std::optional<HostAllowance> authorised
  std::vector<std::string> withheld
  std::int64_t loads
  std::string why
struct PickResult
  Observation observation
  Decision decision
struct OfferRequest
  std::string profile
  Placement placement
  std::int64_t reserve
  bool fresh
struct Offer
  std::string family
  std::vector<std::string> names
  std::vector<std::string> servers
  std::int64_t context
  std::string context_source
  std::int64_t input
  std::vector<std::string> unknown
struct OfferSnapshot
  Observation observation
  std::vector<Offer> offers
  OfferOutcome outcome
inline std::string encode(const PickRequest& v)
inline PickRequest decode(std::string_view data)
struct FrameWriter
  virtual void write_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct DispatchError : std::runtime_error
struct FrameExchanger
  virtual std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct ServiceError : std::runtime_error
  std::string code, message
inline constexpr std::string_view kEndpointContract
struct DescribedService
  std::string contract
  bool ready
  std::string why
std::string describe_endpoint(std::string_view frame, const std::string& program, const std::string& version, const Services& . . . services)
struct Router
  virtual ModelsSnapshot models(const bool& fresh)
  virtual HostsSnapshot hosts(const bool& fresh)
  virtual PickResult pick(const PickRequest& request)
  virtual OfferSnapshot offer(const OfferRequest& request)
template<class Transport>struct RouterClient : Router
  Transport& transport_
  ModelsSnapshot models(const bool& fresh) override
  HostsSnapshot hosts(const bool& fresh) override
  PickResult pick(const PickRequest& request) override
  OfferSnapshot offer(const OfferRequest& request) override
struct RouterService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct RouterDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  Router& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
